messages:
Maya (Marketing): Need a minimal battlecard refresh for next Tue's webinar. Goal: crisp benchmark angle vs cloud-managed endpoints, 3 SDR hooks, and a routing rule for high-velocity trials.

Ethan (Product): Keep claims differentiated: serving-layer controls (quant profiles + kernel selection), deployment parity (same API across hosted/ded/private), and tail-latency guarantees when using Dedicated pools.

Rosa (Eng-ML): Bench quick-note: redwood-runtime shows ~18-32% lower effective token cost on mixed-chat when using adaptive batching + quant profiles; tail reduced by ~20-35ms on our workload. Will drop graphs.

Dee (Sales): SDR hooks (short):
- Econ: "Turn serving knobs to cut token spend—no black box billing."
- Latency: "Engineered tail-control for consistent UX at scale."
- Compliance: "Bring-your-own KMS and audit trails for regulated workloads."

Zoe (Growth): Landing copy tests: A) "Ship features with serving controls, not vendor guesswork." B) "Control costs with operational knobs, not opaque endpoints." I'll A/B both.

Cal (Field): Procurement rebuts (two): 1) "Managed endpoints hide unit-econ levers; Redwood exposes quant and batching controls for predictable spend." 2) "We support VPC, KMS, and on-prem packages for auditability and data locality."

Rosa (Eng-ML): Webinar demo plan: 1) show cost curve change when enabling quant profile; 2) simulate a region outage -> route to Dedicated pool with quantized-lite model; 3) surface audit log entry for key access. Keep <6 minutes.

Maya (Marketing): Routing rule: form field 'deployment_need' (options: hosted/dedicated/private) -> if 'dedicated' or 'private' tag AE:Field and route to specialized trial queue. Zoe add hidden utm=serving-controls.

webinar-bot: Reminder: Collateral freeze 2026-07-09 23:59 UTC.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks—I'll stitch the battlecard and circulate a 1-pager by EOD Friday. Ping if you can't deliver assets.
